owner_and_capability: Transaction Runtime (transaction-runtime: modules/transactionruntime/compose) hands the composition roots (root-composition: api, cmd, .) one database value, compose.Database, holding the opened pool and the tenant unit of work bound to it. It offers Pool(), UnitOfWork(), Close() and AddQueryHook() and is built by OpenDatabase (CLI superuser pool), OpenServeDatabase (phoenix_auth serve pool with lock-wait observation), OpenDemoDatabase (restricted standing-demo pool), NewDatabase and NewDemoDatabase (existing pools). ADR 0053, point 5; slice of #2750.
affected_tables: None: code-only composition change, no database tables or DDL affected.
atomic_cutover: One PR, no policy epoch change. modules/transactionruntime/compose gains the defined type Database (not an alias) with its constructors; opening constructors close the pool when binding the unit of work fails. Closing the pool and attaching a query hook stay in the Postgres role through database.ClosePool and database.AttachQueryHook; the unused database.InitDB is deleted. database/migrations gains migrations.Operation so the CLI roots keep migration functions without naming the ORM, and a missing migration operation fails before the database opens. api, cmd and . hold only the Database value and pass Pool() and UnitOfWork() to the unchanged owner compositions and services builders; serveGraph and the cleanup context drop their separate unit of work field (serveGraph 9 -> 8 fields) and NewDemoRuntime takes the unit of work of its database value. Root internal tests reach the value through testpkg.Database and testpkg.NewDatabase until #4001 lets them import transactionruntime/compose. Five #2750 keys fall (60 -> 55): api -> bun, cmd -> bun, both database.direct-access keys and cmd -> database. Owner composition signatures, Factory fields and setters, routes, status codes, error texts, pool privileges and tables are unchanged; composition surface stays at 252.
